name: vllm-rocm-halo-main
description: vLLM v0.22.0 runtime for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151), ASSEMBLED from the prebuilt wheel pkg (vllm-wheel-halo) onto the rocm/vllm 7.13 base + transformers 5.10.2 (full multimodal). No source compile (~2 min). Rebuild the wheel pkg (vllm-rocm-halo-wheel) first when bumping vLLM or the base image. Legacy one-shot compile-in-place Dockerfile kept at Dockerfile.legacy.
